name: gaps2-x89-magen
description: X-89 Bacterial Weapon (base and Ω) and Magen Defense Grid (base) — audit-gaps-2 (gate TI4_RULES_TECH / rulesGateTech). Texts: X-89 (base) 'ACTION: Exhaust this card and choose 1 planet in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships that have BOMBARDMENT; destroy all infantry on that planet.' X-89 Ω 'After 1 or more of your units use BOMBARDMENT against a planet, if at least 1 of your opponent's infantry was destroyed, you may destroy all of your opponent's infantry on that planet.' Magen Defense Grid (base) 'You may exhaust this card at the start of a round of ground combat on a planet that contains 1 or more of your units that have PLANETARY SHIELD; your opponent cannot make combat rolls this combat round.' pbd72@815: Winnu (both X-89s, Magen base, a PDS on Lodor) — X-89 Ω without a BOMBARDMENT is refused; X-89 (base) on Abyz (no BOMBARDMENT ship there) is refused; Magen: Muaat lands 2 infantry on Lodor (ground combat), Winnu exhausts Magen, Muaat's round-1 roll is refused. Original: none of these were automated. (gate: a real ground combat on Lodor is started first, winnu's infantry vs muaat's, so the roll Magen blocks is a real prompt; without it the harness had to synthesize the roll's carrier, which the engine missed under load.)
